q: How does BEE star rate air compressors?
title: BEE star rating for air compressors
short: BEE rates fixed speed screw and reciprocating compressors of 0.37 to 500 kW on isentropic efficiency at full load. In the 2020 schedule, an air-cooled 11 to 30 kW unit needed 54 percent for 1 star and 78 percent for 5 stars. Labelling is voluntary.

p: Schedule 27 covers electrically driven, fixed speed, oil-lubricated rotary and reciprocating compressors, air or water cooled, at 5 bar(g) or more, rated 0.37 to 500 kW. The rating is isentropic efficiency: the ideal compression power divided by the measured packaged input power, tested to IS/ISO 1217.

sections.h: Air-cooled bands in the 2020 schedule (isentropic efficiency)
ul: 0.37 to under 11 kW: 1 star 44 to 50 percent; 5 star 68 or more.
11 to 30 kW: 1 star 54 to 60; 5 star 78 or more.
37 to 55 kW: 1 star 66 to 70; 5 star 82 or more.
75 to 185 kW: 1 star 71 to 75; 5 star 87 or more.
200 to 500 kW: 1 star 73 to 77; 5 star 89 or more.

sections.h: Before you rely on the bands
p: The schedule BEE publishes marks these as voluntary phase tables valid to 31 December 2022. Check the current table on BEE's star label portal before using a band in a tender. Your site saving still depends on pressure, leaks and controls more than on the label.

senseible: Senseible tracks compressor house electricity through your bills, so the effect of a new machine or a leak fix shows up in monthly kWh.
